text: Visitors have noted ongoing issues with crowding, which affects their ability to fully experience the exhibits despite timed entry tickets. Several reviews mention confusion about ticket purchasing, particularly the requirement to buy tickets online in advance and the inability to pay with cash onsite. Parking has also been a concern, with some visitors frustrated by limited spaces and large vehicles occupying multiple spots. While many appreciate the interactive exhibits and architecture, some express dissatisfaction with the heavy use of AI in the displays and the lack of clear directional signage inside the library. The gift shop received criticism for its limited selection of items representing the library.
